authority.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

implementation.behavior: Rejects a null default target or a default handle whose wire code is not DRW::DwgHardPointer before publishing the typed target. Parse failure invalidates the buffer and clears partial dictionary state.
implementation.scope: Wire-role validation only; target existence, target type, ownership, and emitted output remain governed by P4 graph closure.

cases: Generated AC1015 hard-pointer default edge parses with exact entry fields.
A following soft-pointer sentinel remains readable, proving cursor alignment.
The same frame with its default edge changed to a soft pointer is rejected and leaves no typed dictionary state.

supplementalPhysicalInput.worktreeState: Untracked local input at the time of this check; it was read without modification and was not added by this slice.
supplementalPhysicalInput.observedDefault: DWG handle code 5 (hard pointer), reference 0x0F; the object parsed without an object-parse failure.
supplementalPhysicalInput.wholeFileResult: Strict conversion remained refused because the source read disposition is incomplete (23 Reader21 AC1021 CRC mismatches); no DXF output qualification is claimed.

fixturePolicy: The vector is authored in memory; no drawing fixture was added.
claimBoundary: This proves rejection of an invalid default-reference wire role and preservation of parser rollback/alignment for the generated AC1015 profile.
It does not prove that a real source target exists, has the required object type or owner, is emitted, or is accepted by a native consumer.
No format support claim was promoted.
